positions.name: RehearsalCadenceRestatement
positions.frame: how does the direct statement of the rehearsal cadence relate to its restatement as a structured decision-record field?
positions.why: src-1 is Quinton's direct, unhedged declaration that Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly; src-3 restates the same cadence fact as a labeled 'Cadence' entry in decision-record form, explicitly retaining Quinton as animator/author/principal rather than shifting footing to the session. Read together, both expressions answer the same underlying question of what the cadence is and who stands behind it, one as spoken utterance and one as its formalized restatement.
